reference.label: Drylendar reference, edited and redacted
reference.alt: Edited Drylendar reference showing Settings, calendar appearance controls with the timezone hidden, and the drink-count editor changing from green through yellow, orange and red to a dark blackout state.
reference.description: A portrait phone recording opens in Settings with purchases, notifications, calendar, social-account and privacy controls. A hard cut shows Intermediate shades, appearance choices and a timezone row whose value is covered by an opaque rectangle. Another cut opens the zero-drink editor. It briefly closes to the user's calendar and reopens. The count rises through ten while the card changes color, and a Blackout toggle changes it between red and dark gray. Down/up arrows, Submit and Cancel remain visible. This silent excerpt does not establish persistence or all gesture behavior.
reference.posterAlt: Drylendar's green zero-drink editor with down/up arrows, Submit and Cancel.
reference.credit: Reference UI: Drylendar by App Craft Consulting. User-supplied screen recording. Independent DryLender recreation; no affiliation or endorsement implied.

clone.label: Edited simulator walkthrough; demo replays user-provided history
clone.alt: Edited DryLender simulator walkthrough with captions, showing the calendar and SobriScore, multi-day fill, a past-day editor, Party-mode Live Activity with a permission prompt, reward cards, and CSV export controls.
clone.description: A title introduces DryLender. Captioned segments show a monthly calendar, a SobriScore sheet and yearly grids, then range selection and a multi-day drink card. Balloon animations cross the calendar. A past-day editor changes a drink count and returns to the calendar. Party mode opens a drink card and then a Lock Screen Live Activity with the iOS permission prompt still open. Reward cards open and animate. The final section opens Settings and a CSV export share sheet. The supplied edit retains all cuts and held frames. There is no audio.
clone.posterAlt: DryLender's orange five-drink editor beneath the caption Edit any past day, with down/up arrows, Submit and Cancel.
limitations: The Live Activity permission prompt remains open; successful Lock Screen arrow interactions and removal on close are not demonstrated.
This pre-build-4 recording predates the real-touch single-tap gesture fix and does not demonstrate that fix.
Balloons are visible, but no balloon pop or haptics are recorded.
The export share sheet is shown, but a completed import or export/import round trip is not.
Cuts and held frames prevent latency claims. Existing captions are retained section labels, not independent behavior verification.
